claim_traces.claim_text: "Napoleon Bonaparte was unusually short — around 5 feet 2 inches tall."
reasoning_steps: The claim that Napoleon Bonaparte was unusually short at around 5 feet 2 inches is a well-documented historical myth
Following his death, his autopsy recorded his height as 5 feet 2 inches ("5 pieds 2 pouces") in pre-metric French units
However, French inches (*pouces*) were longer than English/Imperial inches (approximately 2.7 cm versus 2.54 cm)

Converted to modern Imperial measurements, Napoleon was approximately 5 feet 6 inches to 5 feet 7 inches (around 168–170 cm) tall, which was average or slightly above average for a French male in the early 19th century
The misconception of him being unusually short stemmed from conversion errors and British wartime propaganda (such as caricatures by James Gillray).
